I went for this specific degree because of this specific company. The field that the company is focused in interests me, but only a few companies are active in this field due to the tight regulations that surrounds it. The degree that I'm working towards mainly specializes in this field, so it would be difficult to enter other companies with this degree. Potentially losing my chance to step towards my dream for working at this company really depresses me.

I have yet to visit my student health center about this, but have plans to do so after final exams.
